review: An unexpectedly strong unit released on the 8th Walpurgisnacht. [Lobotomy E.G.O::Faint Aroma & Solitude] Ryōshū is a versatile Sinking unit and is suitable for all 3 Yi Sang-based archetypes with good Tremor potential. She has a lot on her plate, so let’s look closer at what she does. Starting with her unique effects, she has plenty of them. - Faint Aroma is her main debuff; her skillset revolves around it. It is applied whenever the enemy takes damage. It gets spread on Tremor bursts. On max stack, it triggers a Tremor Burst and makes the enemy take Gloom damage based on the Sinking stack. Consider it a mini Sinking Deluge. - Petals is a self-stacking buff that is gained on dodge and through infliction of Faint Aroma.
